cases.prompt: Tables: orders(id, customer_id, total, created_at), customers(id, name). Write a query for the top 5 customers by total spend in 2025.
cases.expect: A correct SQL query joining orders to customers, filtering 2025 dates, grouping by customer, summing total, ordering descending and limiting to 5. Brief explanation.

cases.prompt: Explain: SELECT department, COUNT(*) FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 10;
cases.expect: Explains it counts employees per department and keeps only departments with more than 10, in plain words.
